function.name: hunt_import
function.description: Import hunting property parcel boundaries, waypoints, or routes from GPX/KML/KMZ/GeoJSON/county PDF/trail-cam EXIF, or auto-fetch public state GIS parcels (Wisconsin SCO/WROC) from a lat/lon coordinate.

property_name.description: Name of the hunting camp or property (e.g. 'Northwoods 40').

file_path.description: Optional path to GPX, KML, KMZ, GeoJSON, county parcel PDF, or trail-cam JPEG.

lat.description: Latitude of property center (auto-fetches state GIS parcels if provided).

channel_id.description: Optional Discord channel ID when visibility is channel_private.

function.name: hunt_export
function.description: Export a hunting property's stands, blinds, bedding waypoints, access trails, and parcels to GPX 1.1 or KML format for direct import back into onX Hunt or a handheld GPS.

publish_discord.description: If true, publish and attach the exported file to the active Discord channel.

function.name: hunt_weather
function.description: Fetch hyper-local Open-Meteo hourly wind speed/direction, gusts, barometric pressure trend, thermal mode, and NOAA astronomical DNR legal shooting hours.

lat.description: Property latitude (optional if property_id is given).

lon.description: Property longitude (optional if property_id is given).

property_id.description: Property ID to pull coordinates from.

function.name: hunt_plan
function.description: Evaluate and rank all stands/blinds on a property for a given wind direction, speed, and thermal mode, detecting downwind hunter-to-hunter scent conflicts with shapely.

function.name: hunt_render_map
function.description: Render a high-DPI matplotlib tactical aerial/topo map with parcel boundaries, stand labels, Gaussian/katabatic scent cones, live mobile hunter GPS arrows, compass rose, and scale bar. Optionally posts directly to Discord.

basemap.description: Offline-cached Esri Hybrid / USGS basemap layer (default 'hybrid').

view_bbox.description: Optional [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat] viewport bounds matching the active Web UI map view.

publish_discord.description: If true, publish to artifact pantry and attach to Discord.

function.name: hunt_log
function.description: Add or update a stand/blind/bedding/camera waypoint, log a deer sighting, or update property camp privacy (public vs channel_private).

kind.description: Waypoint kind: stand, blind, bedding, camera, scrape, parking, camp.

preferred_winds.description: Comma-separated favorable wind directions e.g. NW,W,NNW.

function.name: hunt_mobile
function.description: Inspect live mobile GPS & compass heading telemetry from hunters in the field or issue a scoped X-Beacon-Token for an Android / mobile web hunting companion.

hunter_id.description: Unique slug for hunter when issuing a beacon token.

function.name: hunt_plan_save
function.description: Save, inspect ('get'), list, delete, or append a Follow-Up Q&A turn ('followup') to a tactical Hunting Plan in Hunting Buddy's SQLite archive so it renders in the Web UI Plans panel and persists across sessions.

action.description: Plan archive action (default 'save'). Use 'update' to enrich an existing plan_id; 'get' to inspect a plan + annotations + Q&A; 'followup' to persist a Q&A reply.

plan_id.description: Plan ID (for update, get, delete, or followup).

plan_mode.description: Plan mode: 'fish' for fishing/lake bathymetry briefings, 'hunt' for hunting briefings.

source_task_id.description: Optional workflow task ID for deduplication.

answer_markdown.description: Markdown tactical answer to the follow-up question (for action='followup').

title.description: Concise plan title (e.g. 'Opening Morning NW 8 mph Sit Plan').

shooting_light.description: Legal shooting hours dict (start, end, sunrise, sunset).

top_stands.description: Ranked recommended stands with safety rationale.

blown_stands.description: Stands to avoid on this wind.

briefing_markdown.description: Full Markdown tactical hunting plan briefing.

map_png_path.description: Optional path to rendered PNG tactical map.

annotations.description: Optional removable tactical map objects (Point pins, LineString approach routes/deer corridors, Polygon bedding/avoid zones) attached to this plan.

coordinates.description: Coordinate array for Point [lon,lat], LineString [[lon,lat],...], or Polygon [[[lon,lat],...]].

function.name: hunt_annotate
function.description: Add, list, toggle, or remove removable tactical map objects (recommended stand pins, stealth approach routes, deer travel corridors, bedding zones, pinch points, avoid zones) on the live Hunting Buddy Leaflet map.

plan_id.description: Optional parent plan_id to group annotations as a removable layer.

label.description: Short map label (e.g. 'Stealth West Creek Approach').

notes.description: Tactical rationale shown in map popup.

annotations.description: Optional batch array of annotations to add in one call.

function.name: hunt_topo
function.description: Query or fetch high-resolution USGS 3DEP 1m LiDAR elevation grids (with Copernicus 30m fallback), hypsometric elevation-gradient contours (2/5/10/20 ft intervals), slope/thermal drainage vectors, and topographic/habitat landmarks (water sources, ridges, saddles, drainages, benches, uploaded LiDAR/topo features) for a hunting camp.

contour_step_ft.description: Optional contour interval in feet (e.g. 2, 5, 10, 20; 0 = auto).

function.name: hunt_routes
function.description: Manage traced streams (with downstream flow direction), walking/entry trails, ATV/driving roads, deer trails, and fishing current seams; sync nationwide/global USGS NHD + OSM Overpass hydrography & roads; inspect pluggable spatial provider health or build an Offline Camp Pack.

name.description: Name of stream, trail, or road (e.g. 'North Creek' or 'West Logging Road').

coordinates.description: LineString coordinate pairs [[lon,lat], ...] (start->end = downstream for streams).

function.name: hunt_fish
function.description: Guide-grade fishing, lake dossier & hydrology tool: sync & cache lakes/reservoirs/ponds (WI DNR 24K + official LakeDetail facts & SWIMS bathymetric map PDFs -> USGS NHD -> Global OSM), create/edit custom ponds (e.g. Northwoods Pond), fetch live USGS NWIS / global GloFAS river gauges, compute 0-100 Solunar & Barometric Bite Index + windward shore + species rigging matrix, manage fish structure pins, water current flow vectors, depth contour traces, and shoreline-clipped bathymetry contours.

property_id.description: Property / camp ID (defaults to active camp).

waterbody_id.description: Saved waterbody ID (for prepare_chart_tiles, extract_depths_from_chart, or estimate_bathymetry).

coord_space.description: For extract_depths_from_chart: use 'aligned' when nx/ny come from prepare_chart_tiles North-up grid/quadrants (0=W/N, 1=E/S); 'raw' for unrotated original scan.

clear_prior_vision.description: For extract_depths_from_chart: if true, replace prior chart_vision points for this lake.

samples.description: For extract_depths_from_chart: list of {nx, ny, depth_ft} (normalized 0.0-1.0 coords) or {lat, lon, depth_ft}.

contour_lines.description: For extract_depths_from_chart: list of {depth_ft, points: [{nx, ny}, ...]}.

structures.description: For extract_depths_from_chart: list of {name, kind, nx, ny, depth_ft, notes}.

wbic.description: Official state waterbody ID (e.g. WI DNR WBIC 540600).
